full_description:
Cabinet for Electric Bass

  • Equipped with 4 x 10" custom voiced bass woofers + 1 x 3" custom voiced tweeter
  • Power rating: 450 Watts
  • Impedance: 8 ohms
  • Frequency response: 60 Hz - 20,000 Hz
  • Housing made of 15 mm poplar plywood
  • Connections: 6.3 mm jack & speaker twist socket
  • On/off switch for the tweeter
  • Dimensions (W x D x H): 600 x 380 x 635 mm
  • Weight: 32.3 kg
  • Design: Bronco-style Tolex covering and British-style grille cloth
